label: Standard Rules
description: No special restrictions — build freely from the full roster pool.
effectSummary: Normal draft rules — full roster available.

label: No Point Guards
description: Primary point guards are removed from this pool. You'll need playmaking elsewhere.
effectSummary: DISADVANTAGE — Primary point guards cannot be drafted.

label: No Centers
description: Centers are removed from this pool. Small-ball or position-flex only.

label: Under 25 Only
description: Only young players under age 25 qualify. High upside, less polish.
effectSummary: DISADVANTAGE — Only players age 24 and under.

label: 3-Season Pool
description: Pool includes the spin year plus one season on each side — three seasons total.

label: No All-Stars
description: All-Star selections are excluded. Role players and hidden gems only.
effectSummary: DISADVANTAGE — All-Star players removed from pool.

label: Veterans Only
description: Only players age 30+ qualify. Experience over upside.

label: Rookie Wave
description: Only first- and second-year players qualify. Raw talent, steep learning curve.

label: Defense First
description: Only players with 80+ defense rating qualify. Grind-it-out rosters.

label: Sharpshooters
description: Only players with 85+ shooting rating qualify. Spacing specialists only.

label: Home Court Edge
description: Your lineup gets a big simulation boost — every game feels like a home crowd.

label: Injury Risk
description: A random player takes a health hit before the season sim. Depth matters.
effectSummary: DISADVANTAGE — Random player loses 18 health & −8% win chance.
